description: This Java source file defines the OrderValueList class, which extends MethodOperation and implements functionality for the <order-value-list> element in the OFBiz mini-language. It handles ordering of entity lists based on specified order-by criteria, as well as relevant validation, creation, and string representation methods.

classes.name: OrderValueList
classes.description: Represents the <order-value-list> element used within the mini-language to order a list of entities based on specified criteria. It holds references to the list to be ordered, the ordering criteria, and the resulting list, and provides execution and string representation methods.

classes.name: OrderValueListFactory
classes.description: Factory class to instantiate OrderValueList objects from XML elements.

methods.name: OrderValueList
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the object with XML element attributes, performing validation and setting up accessors.

methods.name: exec
methods.description: Executes the ordering operation on the list by applying the specified order criteria.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the <order-value-list> element with its attributes.
